  Had been to this place on a team outing. Ramee Guestline is pretty far from the city, but quite easy to spot. The first look of the place is decent. Coming to lunch, the food lacked variety, especially the non vegetarian buffet. This is the only buffet I have been to so far, where chicken starters and main course are not served, the only dish with chicken being chicken biryani. The non veg buffet was all about fish. So if you are a non vegetarian who doesn't like fish (I know a quite of them actually), you will have to depend on veggies... Besides that, the buffet was pretty okay! Except for the gajar halwa in the desserts section- it was the worst halwa I have ever had. Around 4 pm, tea was served with hot pakoras, which again were not great..

  Amazing place. Saturday nights can be a little crowded. The food is really good. Service has to improve a lot. The pub is understaffed. Ambience is okayish. There was a dj night going on. Dance floor is small but then there aren't many people there.
For starters we ordered the fries basket. This comprised of French fries, wedges and potato balls. This was really good and worth the money. Their sauce has a different flavour to it
We tried the classic grilled chicken cheese burger. This was also good.
As for the main course, we ordered the Jolly good mixed grill sizzlet. This was really good.
We were informed that the food orders would take a min of 20-30 mins for the preparation.
Staff are friendly."), ('Rated 3.0', "RATED
  It was extremely difficult to spot this place. There's just a small board with it's name written above vallet parking.

Food: I ordered a veg paneer burger. It was tasty and very well presented. My Friends ordered the chicken starters and fish.. they were apparently very bad. Their strawberry mocktail was pretty good.

Ambience: this place has a good ambience and a dance floor as well.
Service: it was extremely slow. They took twenty mins to bring our orders. But the waiters were helpful And nice.")]

address: 104, 5th Floor, Industrial Area, Koramangala 5th Block, Bangalore
name: Karama Restaurant
dish_liked: Mutton Mandi, Laccha Paratha, Chicken Curry, Tawa Chicken, Rabri, Raan, Biryani
reviews_list:
[('Rated 5.0', "RATED
  Karama is one such great restaurant for get-together. Their ambience is awestruck, the moment you enter the restaurant you'll feel you have come to a Palace. Their service is really great too.. Coming to the food..
We ordered Saudi spicy potato, hummus, barbecue dajaj for starters and for the main course we ordered chicken kheem naan, murgh masala, murgh Malai and kastoori kebab, for the desserts we had jilebi with rabdi and gulam jamoon..

I will give 10/10 for everything, its the best food I ever tasted.. Lovely ppl and lovely food"), ('Rated 4.0', 'RATED
  Had been to this place and was amazed by the ambience. Ordered butter roti, dal fry alfam and biryani rice. Loved the taste. Would love to visit again'), ('Rated 3.0', "RATED
  Wonderful ambiance!!
The restaurant is a subsidiary of the Empire Restaurant group and is better than their parent company, I feel.
The quantity of the dishes served aren't great with the price of the dish.
Hummus tasted just like Peanut Butter chutney.
Otherwise the food was made pretty well.
The Sizzler was sizzling hot and the quantity was better than other dishes.
Food :3.8/5
Ambiance : 4.8/5
Service : 3.8/5
Food Taste and Quality to be improved."), ('Rated 3.0', "RATED
  This place is a let down compared to the mosque road outlet. First, they didn't have mutton nihari, which I feel is the best thing they serve. Service is very slow, it took around 10 minutes each time, to get hold of a waiter.

The food was average, nothing specifically bad, but nothing stand out. Overall a disappointment, considering the karama name."), ('Rated 1.0', "RATED
  Wish I could give negative stars. I specifically remember how rude, unwelcoming the manager for the place was. Spoiled mood. Didn't like the food. The curry curry was great and the breads were huge!!!

  As 1Q1 has successfully completed one year in the city, there's the Asian Street Food Festival that's going on alongside their 1st Anniversary Celebrations.

I dined her last weekend, and we tried various dishes.
We sat in the courtyard, where we could see the dishes being prepared right in front of us. There's Chinese, Japanese, Thai, Vietnamese, Indonesian and Cambodian cuisine on the menu.

My favourite dishes were the Mi Goreng (I preferred the vegetarian one over the Chicken), Lemongrass Chicken Skewers and Chicken Bao.
Something that I tried for the first time were the Vietnamese Rice Paper Rolls (this is made very intricately) and the Mushroom Takoyaki. I think you need an acquired taste for the rice paper rolls as this isn't cooked and is made with fresh veggies and a meat of your choice.

Coming to what I loved was the Classic Cheesecake with Sour Cherry Coulis. This was just perfect.
It was a nice evening with friends where we indulged in some interesting Asian food."), ('Rated 4.0', "RATED

name: FNC Seafood
dish_liked: Sea Food Platter, Fish N Chips, Fish Fingers, Fries, Prawn Noodles
reviews_list:
[('Rated 1.0', "RATED
  One of the worst food place I ate in recent time. Fish & chips were pathetic. They don't even know that they should not deep fry Squid a lot. It changes the texture similar to that of rubber.

They think that Fish & chips means that they have to deep fry everything. They forget that Seafood is having a texture which will be ruined by deep fry in too mi h hot oil.

Simple advice. Don't waste your time & money here. You have a lot of other better places to explore & eat"), ('Rated 4.0', 'RATED
  Ordered the spicy squid rings. Quantity was quite a lot and the squids were fresh and well prepared. Pretty pocket friendly outlet with a lot of combo options to choose from!!'), ('Rated 5.0', 'RATED

  The best sea food stuffs, ever tasted in Bangalore, are available here. Fish and Chips, abbreviated as FNC is a small joint in the Forum Mall food court and they serve very tasty and quality stuff... I am coming back for sure.

  You'd expect a place that has seafood in the name to serve good seafood, but you're wrong. A good lesson for people who get carried away by the book's cover and never look inside.   The combos are nice.
The fish is fresh.
The fries are crisp.
The price is not alright.
The plates need to be replaced.

reviews_list:
[('Rated 3.0', "RATED
  Not at all surprising that the quaint by lanes of Wilson garden would house a biryani joint dishing authentic Karunadu style (Karnataka's very own) Donne Biryani. What else can you expect from streets that turn into a foodie paradise after the sun calls it a day. You can find here a Fiesty Biryani, perhaps not up to the Donne stalwarts, with a compact crew of homely kababs, chilly chicken and pepper mutton. Self service, Honestly priced, nimble and fulfilling. A notice on the wall announces availability of idly and nalli soup as day starters 7am to 9am. << For the uninitiated, 'Donne' is a plate fashioned from a leaf into a boat shape into which piping hot biryani is laden.   A very nice hang out place at very reasonable rates near to Forum Mall. They have an open roof top where they have live music. It has a really nice ambience with a retro theme and some really nice quotes on the walls.

As I had read in most of the reviews before I was there, the food too was really good. We tried Chicken Taka Tak Pizza, Chicken Makhani Gravy with some plain naan and garlic naan. Everything was really delicious. We also tried a Cranberry non alcoholic beer which was also nice and worth a try.

  Pin me down?
Cafe pin me down located near the forum mall koramangala.
They have 2 floor and rooftop with seating capacity of 50people.
The Ambience is awesome and on weekends they have a live music.
I visited this place on sunday evening with friends.
First we had hookah that is bubble gum and brain freezer.
Coming to the food we had:
- Kurkuri romali: A large crispy papad.
-paneer tikka.
-Bread kanda batata.
-Khada seena.
- fish tikka.
-Chicken lollipop.
Main course we had:
-Murgh patiala.
-Kaamal ka kofta.
-Garlic and nigella seeds kulcha.
-Papad ki churi.
-Lasun ki chutney.

Desserts we had:
Gajar ka alva and cocoa brownie.

They have a valet parking too.
Over all Pin me down is a must visit place.

  Rarely you come across a restaurant where you feel like comfort of home.

I visited this place 2 times on different days before writing this review and found the quality of service same.

The restaurant is highly recommended for authentic North Indian food in Koramangala Area.

The ambience is trendy. The service is fast. The menu variety is wide and aptly priced.

The most important and unique point about the service provided by the restaurant is that owner (Harshita) is very humble and flexible according to food choices of customers and allows them to do mix and match in the combos.

In Pics (and also the must try items) : North Indian Thali, Masala Lemonade, Paratha Combo with Dal Makhni (Onion Paratha and Cauliflower Paratha) and very very Yummy Jalebi.

We were welcomed with a musk melon panakkam and refreshing buttermilk. The starters saw a fiery Andhra chilli chicken with raw heat from green chillies. The favourites among them biryanis was the mandya pullao and thalapakatti. Brilliant.!

Ending with a coconut mousse and obattu. Absolute fun !!

Biryani available for rs. 149 till the duration of the festival (31 Jan)

  Best place to take your family or the one you have a comfortable relationship with. A no-frills place serving good quality but not extraordinary food. Inexpensive prices are a boon.

Ordered the podi masala dosa and the urundai for myself. Both were good and almost satisfies the soul. Almost is the key word here.

  We know the military hotels in and around Bangalore right? They are amazing because of their legacy, the stories you hear from the owners, and also mainly because they nail the brief when it comes to preparing only a few dishes, but preparing them very very well. Dande's is NOT such a place. They have a wide variety, but seldom get it right.

That said, their Dande's Special Chicken Biryani is amazing. Don't be taken aback especially after what I wrote in the previous paragraph. Another analogy for Dande's is like watching Meryl Streep in the movie "The Iron Lady". Their special chicken biryani is exactly like that. They serve really good rice with boneless chicken that are mixed with scrambled eggs. Their taste is really really good and goes amazingly well with the rice. This is a Biryani that you can always eat. The best part is that you don't feel super-heavy after binging on it.
